description: Source code for Kubernetes NodeLifecycle Controller managing node taints, health, and disruption states.

classes.name: nodeHealthData
classes.description: Holds timestamped node health status and lease information.

classes.name: nodeHealthMap
classes.description: Thread-safe map storing node health data.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages node lifecycle, including taints, health, and disruption states.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of nodeHealthData.

methods.name: newNodeHealthMap
methods.description: Initializes a new thread-safe node health map.

methods.name: getDeepCopy
methods.description: Retrieves a deep copy of node health data for a given node.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets node health data for a given node.

methods.name: NewNodeLifecycleController
methods.description: Constructs a new node lifecycle controller with configuration and informers.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's event processing and health monitoring loops.

methods.name: doNodeProcessingPassWorker
methods.description: Worker processing node update events for tainting and label reconciliation.

methods.name: doNoScheduleTaintingPass
methods.description: Applies NoSchedule taints based on node conditions.

methods.name: doNoExecuteTaintingPass
methods.description: Applies NoExecute taints to nodes that are unhealthy or unreachable.

methods.name: monitorNodeHealth
methods.description: Monitors node health status, updates conditions, and manages taints.

methods.name: processTaintBaseEviction
methods.description: Handles tainting nodes for eviction based on their conditions.

methods.name: isNodeExcludedFromDisruptionChecks
methods.description: Checks if a node is labeled to be excluded from disruption checks.

methods.name: tryUpdateNodeHealth
methods.description: Attempts to update node health conditions and timestamps.

methods.name: handleDisruption
methods.description: Manages zone disruption states based on node conditions.

methods.name: podUpdated
methods.description: Enqueues pod updates when assigned node changes.

methods.name: doPodProcessingWorker
methods.description: Worker processing pod update events for node readiness.

methods.name: processPod
methods.description: Handles pod readiness marking based on node health.

methods.name: setLimiterInZone
methods.description: Adjusts eviction rate limiters based on zone disruption state.

methods.name: classifyNodes
methods.description: Classifies nodes into added, deleted, and new zone representatives.

methods.name: HealthyQPSFunc
methods.description: Returns default eviction QPS for the cluster.

methods.name: ReducedQPSFunc
methods.description: Returns reduced eviction QPS for large clusters.

methods.name: addPodEvictorForNewZone
methods.description: Initializes eviction metrics and state for new zones.

methods.name: markNodeForTainting
methods.description: Marks a node for tainting based on its condition.

methods.name: markNodeAsReachable
methods.description: Removes unreachable and not-ready taints from a node.

methods.name: ComputeZoneState
methods.description: Determines the disruption state of a zone based on node conditions.

methods.name: reconcileNodeLabels
methods.description: Reconciles node labels to ensure consistency.
